programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: The director is away for a few days and is being replaced by Mrs. Snoeck. She would rather watch cat movies on social media than to take over his task. Pedro sees his chance to become the boss of the school and tells everyone that he can talk to the director through his thoughts. In the name of the director, he says that Mrs. Snoeck can go home. All students believe Pedro, except Soekie and Sebast. They want to stop the madness and find out where the director is. / De directeur is enkele dagen weg en wordt vervangen door mevrouw Snoeck. Ze kijkt liever kattenfilmpjes op sociale media dan zijn taak over te nemen. Pedro ziet zijn kans om baas van de school te worden en maakt iedereen wijs dat hij via zijn gedachten met de directeur kan praten. Uit naam van de directeur, zegt hij dat mevrouw Snoeck naar huis mag. Alle leerlingen geloven Pedro, behalve Soekie en Sebast. Students and veterinarians form the foal brigade and are responsible for the animal in need of care 24 hours a day. / Rudy is een bokje met paratuberculose, een ernstige, ongeneeslijke aandoening. En ondanks zijn hoge leeftijd besluit zijn eigenaar om hem te laten opereren. Een van de stallen is als het ware een intensieve zorgafdeling voor veulens. programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later, the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.desc: The first Bundesliga is the highest stage in German club football. It was established on August 24, 1963, it is an essential continuer of the German football championship existing since 1903. The founders of the Bundesliga in 1963 are Borussia Dortmund, Eintracht Braunchschwag, Intracht Frankro, Hamburger, Hurt Berlin Midayndricher, 1860 Munich, Nuremberg, Posen Munster, Saarbrücken, Schalke 04, Stuttgart and Werder. The first champion in 1964 was Cologne. The most successful team in the German First Bundesliga is undoubtedly Bayern Munich, who by 2023, has won 32 titles from 60 championships. / Първа Бундеслига е най-високото стъпало в германския клубен футбол. Създадена е на 24 август 1963 г.,тя е естевен продължител на Германския футболен шампионат, съществуващ от 1903 г. Основатели на Бундеслигата през 1963-а са Борусия Дортмунд, Айнтрахт Брауншвайг, Айнтрахт Франкфурт, Хамбургер ШФ, Херта Берлин, Кайзерслаутерн, Карлсруе, Кьол, Майденрихер, 1860 Мюнхен, Нюрнберг, Пройсен Мюнстер, Саарбрюкен, Шалке 04, Щутгарт и Вердер. Първият шампион през 1964 г. е Кьолн. Най-успешен отбор в немската Първа Бундеслига безспорно е Байерн Мюнхен, който до 2023 г., е спечели 32 титли от 60 издания на първенството.

The team with the most titles won is Real Madrid, but tightly followed by Barcelona. The Spanish Championship gave us some of the greatest players and coaches in the world throughout history. / Испанската баскетболна лига е основана през 1957 г. като Национална лига и получава настоящия си формат през 1983 г., когато организацията ACB поема контрола над състезанието. programme.desc: The National Basketball Association (in English: National Basketball Association, NBA), abbreviated NBA, is the most prestigious world male professional basketball league and among the 4 main professional sports leagues in North America. programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2017) Although it has not been operating for about eighty years, the railway that has connected the Istrian landscapes and has lived in the memory of the inhabitants of these regions. At the beginning of the 20th century, when Perenzana began to be built, a narrow -gauge railway that connected 33 places from Trieste to Poreč, its route went through one state - the Austro -Hungarian Monarchy. If it existed today, this railway would be international since it had 13 in Italy, 32 and Croatia 78 kilometers in Slovenia. Parenzana has functioned for thirty years - until 1935. When it was abolished, the rails were removed, but much of its route and even infrastructure - buildings, bridges, tunnels, viaducts - the Parenzan project - a path of health and friendship - revitalizes the former popular railway, and some facilities are governed. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2017) Premda ne prometuje već osamdesetak godina, željeznica koja je povezivala istarske krajolike i mjesta živi u sjećanju stanovnika ovih krajeva. Početkom 20. stoljeća kad se počela graditi Perenzana, uskotračna željeznička pruga koja je povezivala 33 mjesta od Trsta do Poreča, njezina je trasa išla kroz jednu državu - Austro-Ugarsku Monarhiju. Kad bi danas postojala, ta bi pruga bila međunarodna budući da je u Italiji imala 13, u Sloveniji 32 i Hrvatskoj 78 kilometara. Parenzana je funkcionirala tridesetak godina - do 1935. Kad je ukinuta, tračnice su uklonjene, no sačuvan je velik dio njezine trase pa i infrastrukture - zgrade, mostovi, tuneli, vijadukti... Posljednjih godina Projekt Parenzana - Put zdravlja i prijateljstva - revitalizira nekadašnju popularnu željeznicu, pa se pojedini objekti i sama trasa uređuju - u prvom redu kao biciklističke i pješačke staze. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Planet in transformation / Planet u preobrazbi
programme.desc: Changing Planet: River Restoration - (Nature. Film, England, 2025), in the spotlight, two leading world projects were found with the purpose of resolving the crisis of Rijeka on Earth: one in the American west and the other in Paris. Rivers are the most precious resource in the world. They supply two billion people in the world with drinking water. But river species disappear twice as fast as land and marine life. In the first such project in the world, four gigantic dams will be removed from the River Kamath in California, which is the largest project of its kind so far. During this time, a project worth 1.5 billion pounds was implemented in France with the aim of cleaning Seine. Both projects symbolize a global struggle for the rescue of fragile river systems of the world, which is one of the biggest problems of our planet. R .: Caroline El-Majradi ... / Changing Planet: River Restoration - (prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) U središtu pozornosti našla su se dva vodeća svjetska projekta sa svrhom rješavanja krize rijeka na Zemlji: jedan na američkom Zapadu, a drugi u Parizu. Rijeke su najdragocjeniji resurs na svijetu. Opskrbljuju dvije milijarde ljudi svijeta pitkom vodom. No riječne vrste nestaju dvostruko brže od kopnenog i morskog života. U prvom takvom projektu na svijetu četiri gigantske brane bit će uklonjene s rijeke Klamath u Kaliforniji, što je dosad najveći projekt te vrste. Za to vrijeme u Francuskoj se provodi projekt vrijedan 1,5 milijardi funti s ciljem čišćenja Seine. Oba projekta simboliziraju globalnu borbu za spašavanje krhkih riječnih sustava svijeta, što je jedan od najvećih problema našeg planeta. R.: Caroline El-Marazki...

After the initial shock when she discovers that her new home is actually a monastery, not a private clinic, she gradually gets used to life with nuns and working in a community full of peculiar characters - including Conchitu Warren, who expects the 25th child. With Jenny, we will experience all the joy and challenges that the midwife job brings. Kada stiže u Poplar, mlada primalja Jenny Lee ne zna gotovo ništa o siromaštvu, problemima - pa ni o samom životu. Uskoro počinje surađivati s časnim sestrama iz kuće Nonnatus, redovnicama koje se bave sestrinstvom, i pridružuje se timu primalja koje pružaju skrb trudnicama - osobito onima iz najsiromašnijih četvrti. Ovdje su ulice pune djece, a budući da rodilište ima samo osam kreveta, većina porođaja odvija se kod kuće. Jenny na biciklu obilazi trudnice i rodilje, upoznajući likove poput Conchite, koja je trudna 25. put, i Mary, petnaestogodišnje prostitutke koja nosi svoje prvo dijete. Serija Call the Midwife donosi fascinantan prikaz zajednice na pragu velikih društvenih promjena. ------- Proljeće je 1957. godine. Jenny Lee, tek diplomirana primalja, dolazi u istočni London. Nakon početnog šoka kad otkriva da je njezin novi dom zapravo samostan, a ne privatna klinika, postupno se privikava na život s časnim sestrama i rad u zajednici prepunoj osebujnih likova - uključujući Conchitu Warren, koja očekuje 25. dijete. programme.desc: The Goldbergs-(S10, E15, Comedy, USA, 2023) Once not so long ago and not so far, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) with a video camera documents life on the outskirts of the 1980s. She has full hands of work, starting with Mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who is well-meaning but choke him, through the temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to the rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orranti) and the hypersensible brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And there is also a reasons grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when it comes to more beautiful things in life. Driving watches, first jobs, applications for college and acquiring new friends without losing their old ones, it's all part of the Goldberg family. Some leave their childhood behind them in search of the first kiss, others are tormented by the upbringing of teenagers or, faced with aging, remember the youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience all that. programme.desc: Blessed Ozzy Osbourne - (Doc. Film, USA, 2011), a forty -year career of Ozzy Osbourne as a culturally relevant musician there is no precedent, but his personal struggles are wrapped in Veli Mita and secrets. In some aspects of Ozzy's glory, it is based on his high drug intake and alcohol into the body, while his musical achievements are overshadowed by his "lunatic" person. Originally from a working -class family in war devastated England, Osbourne and his neighborhood friends founded Black Sabbath and invented "heavy metal". For ten years, Ozzy pleased to hold a myth of the rock-and rock lunatic, a leading life that was extreme even in the most liberal standards of his profession. Life was so flowing for a while, but then he began to return the blows. He lost his family, his wife, even the means of life when he received an expulsion from Black Sabbath. The glamor was gone, the fun was passed. Only an alcoholic with a mortal verdict remained. Surprisingly, he managed to step from the grave, with one foot, thanks to his wife and manager Sharon, who organized a return, as unexpected as triumphant. Ozzy became one of the best -selling artists of the 1980s. He recorded the albums of Blizzard of Oz and Diary of a Madman - plates that remain a cultural stone foundation for three generations of music fans. The introductory guitar solo Osbourne's song Crazy Train is known today as (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction Rolling Stones or Day Tripper Beatles. The image of the lunatic was strengthened when Ozzy bit his head pigeon during a meeting at a record label. Later, he bite on stage in a bat. He was crazy. He loved it, and his fans loved it even more. But good times did not last. The tragedy came to Osbourne when his music associate Randy Rhoads died in a plane crash during a 1982 tour. Rhoads' death, as well as the death of Osbourne's father, pushed him into a long -long path for almost 30 years. U nekim aspektima Ozzyjeva slava temelji se na njegovom velikom unosu droge i alkohola u organizam dok su njegova glazbena postignuća zasjenjena njegovom personom "luđaka". Podrijetlom iz radničke obitelji u ratom razorenoj Engleskoj, Osbourne i njegovi prijatelji iz kvarta osnovali su Black Sabbath i izumili "teški metal". Deset godina Ozzy je sa zadovoljstvom održavao mit o rock-and-roll luđaku, vodeći život koji je bio ekstreman čak i po najliberalnijim standardima njegove profesije. Začudo, uspio je iskoračiti iz groba u koji je stupio jednom nogom, zahvaljujući uvelike svojoj supruzi i menadžerici Sharon, koja je organizirala povratak, jednako neočekivan koliko i trijumfalan. Imidž luđaka učvrstio se kada je Ozzy odgrizao glavu golubu tijekom sastanka u diskografskoj kući. Poslije je na pozornici zagrizao u šišmiša. Bio je lud. Volio je to, a njegovi obožavatelji voljeli su to još više. Ali dobra vremena nisu potrajala. programme.title: Vivarij / Vivarij
programme.desc: Vivarium - (Horror, Ireland, 2019) Young couple, gemma and tom, want to buy a house. They visit the unusual real estate agent, Martin. Martin tells them about a new settlement called Yonder. Gemma and Tom drive to the settlement with Martin. The houses in Yonder are identical, typical of the suburbs. The settlement is quiet, empty and unearmal. Martin Pair shows the house number nine, then disappears. Gemma and Tom are trying to leave Yonder, but they get lost. Each route returns them to home number nine. The car remains gasoline. The night in the house number nine. The next morning Tom climbs the roof of the house number nine to try to find a way out of Yonder. See that the houses in Yonder extend into infinity. The couple decides to follow the artificial sun, hoping to perform them if they continue to move in one direction. The road returns them to the house number nine. They find a box for delivery full of packaged food and other necessities. The furious Tom set fire to the house number nine, hoping to attract attention. A couple sits in a strange dream in front of the house, wake up and finds a newborn with instructions: "Raise a child and you will be released." R.: Lorcan Finnegan Ul.: Imogen Poots (Gemma), Danielle Ryan (School McCann (Molly), Jesse Eisenberg (Tom), Jonathan Aris (Martin) ... / Vivarium - (horor, Irska, 2019) Mladi par, Gemma i Tom, žele kupiti kuću. Pronalaze kutiju za dostavu punu zapakirane hrane i drugih potrepština. Bijesni Tom zapali kuću broj devet, nadajući se da će to privući pozornost. Par utone u čudan san ispred kuće, budi se i pronalazi novorođenče s uputama: "Odgajajte dijete i bit ćete pušteni." programme.title: New tendencies / Nove tendencije
programme.desc: New tendencies - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2010) The period from 1961 to 1973 in Zagreb's cultural life is especially intense and interesting. In that decade, Zagreb is an international center where world relevant exhibitions are being held and equally such art is created. It was in Zagreb in 1961 that an international artistic movement of a new tendency was founded, and the names that visited Zagreb at the time and participated in the movement of new tendencies today are renowned artists and theorists. Half a century later, in one of the world's largest centers for art and new media, ZKM in Karlsruhe, there is a retrospective of new tendencies. On this occasion, the protagonists of this movement meet and remember their work and atmosphere in which they created. One of the main participants of the new tendency is Croatian artist Ivan Picelj (1924 - 2011), so this film is also an opportunity to remind a part of the oeuvre of this great creator. R.: Vladislav Knezevic ... / Nove tendencije - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2010) Razdoblje od 1961. do 1973. u zagrebačkom je kulturnom životu posebno intenzivno i zanimljivo. U tom je desetljeću Zagreb međunarodno središte gdje se održavaju svjetski relevantne izložbe te nastaje jednako takva umjetnost. Upravo je u Zagrebu 1961. osnovan međunarodni umjetnički pokret Nove tendencije, a imena koja su tada posjećivala Zagreb i sudjelovala u pokretu Novih tendencija danas su renomirani umjetnici i teoretičari. Pola stoljeća kasnije, u jednom od najvećih svjetskih središta za umjetnosti i nove medije, ZKM u Karlsruheu, održava se retrospektiva Novih tendencija. Tom se prilikom sastaju protagonisti toga pokreta i prisjećaju svojih radova i atmosfere u kojoj su stvarali. Jedan od glavnih sudionika Novih tendencija je hrvatski umjetnik Ivan Picelj (1924. - 2011.), pa je ovaj film ujedno prilika za podsjećanje na dio opusa ovog velikog stvaraoca. R.: Vladislav Knežević...

programme.title: The job is ready / Posao je spreman
programme.desc: The Gig is up - (Doc. Film, Canada, 2021) The film reveals the actual costs of the platform gig economy through the life of workers from all over the world. From food delivery to transportation, millions of people around the world find a job online. The GIG economy is worth more than $ 5 trillion today and is growing globally daily. Yet, the stories of the workers standing behind this technological revolution are generally neglected. Stunned by the promise of flexible working hours, independence and control over time and money, workers from all over the world have found a completely different reality. The working conditions are often no dangerous, the salary is changed without the announcement, and workers may be discharged by the application deactivation or poor user grade. This feature documentary brings their stories. R .: Shannon Walsh ... / The Gig Is Up - (dok. film, Kanada, 2021) Film otkriva stvarne troškove platformske gig ekonomije kroz život radnika iz cijelog svijeta. Od dostave hrane do prijevoza, milijuni ljudi diljem svijeta pronalaze posao online. Gig ekonomija danas vrijedi više od 5 bilijuna američkih dolara i svakodnevno globalno raste. Pa ipak, priče radnika koji stoje iza ove tehnološke revolucije uglavnom su zanemarene. Omamljeni obećanjem fleksibilnog radnog vremena, neovisnosti i kontrole nad vremenom i novcem, radnici iz cijelog svijeta pronašli su sasvim drugačiju stvarnost. Uvjeti rada su često nikakvi i opasni, plaća se mijenja bez prethodne najave, a radnici mogu biti otpušteni deaktivacijom aplikacije ili lošom ocjenom korisnika. programme.title: Listen to the stone / Slušaj kamen
programme.desc: Listen to a stone - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2018) The documentary was created as part of the International Interrives 6 project, the "past meets the present". It is a meeting in which Mediterranean countries such as Italy, Algeria, Morocco, Croatia, Egypt, Albania, etc. The Croatian film "Listen to the Stone of Stone Down and Work in Pucisca on the Island of Brac told the Life of three Protagonists who are each in their own way (education, processing, resurrection, resurrection, resturities) presented on the topic. The 13 -minute version of the film was awarded at the Tunisia Festival, and it is interesting that the story of the stone has gone to the world - it will be shown on the public television of all project participants. R .: Maya Fišter ... / Slušaj kamen - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2018) Dokumentarni film nastao je u sklopu međunarodnog projekta Interrives 6, izdanja pod nazivom "Prošlost susreće sadašnjost". Riječ je o susretu u kojem su se na temu naslijeđa predstavile mediteranske zemlje poput Italije, Alžira, Maroka, Hrvatske, Egipta, Albanije i dr. Hrvatski film "Slušaj kamen" priča je o tradiciji branja kamena i rada u kamenu u Pučišćima na otoku Braču ispričana kroz život trojice protagonista koji su svaki na svoj način (obrazovanje, obrada, restauracija, trgovina) vezani uz kamen. 13-minutna verzija filma nagrađena je na festivalu u Tunisu, a zanimljivo je i da je priča o kamenu otišla u svijet - prikazat će se na javnim televizijama svih zemalja sudionica projekta. R.: Maja Fišter...

programme.title: Croatian water treasure / Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Croatian Water Treasure - (S02, E01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) Many Zagreb residents and their guests will be surprised by the hidden gentle of a good spirit that watches over a million city. He will tell us some of his stories of history, legends, the richness of the plant and animal world. Back in 1242, Bela IV. He donated the name of Medvednica on the city of Zagreb. Later, at the time of absolutism, they called her Zagreb. It was inhabited by some of our ancient ancestors back in prehistoric times, and for centuries of exploitation of all its wealth, especially water and forests, they made a modern civilization that in 1981 it was declared a nature park. Much more than the shady up in the north, these are Zagreb lungs and a place to rest and fun that hide the veterans and her bats, mines, five hundred Horvat stairs, mountaineering homes and chapels in their womb. And the stories of ancient history, those spoken in Zagreb - about the Black Queen and a treasure buried under the ancient Medvedgrad and those spoken in the Croatian Zagorje - about stone from the Svati and Peasant Revolt. And water ... water flowing under the canopy of Sljemes and leaving peacefully to the north - to Zagorje, and to the south - to Zagreb, bring life to everything, even the farthest and darkest corner of Medvednica. R .: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator) ... / Hrvatsko vodeno blago - (S02, E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) Mnogi će se Zagrepčani i njihovi gosti iznenaditi skrivenim blagom dobroga duha koji bdije iznad milijunskoga grada. Ispričat će nam dio njegovih priča o povijesti, legendama, bogatstvu biljnog i životinjskog svijeta. Još davne 1242. godine Bela IV. darovao je gradu Zagrebu posjed na gori imena Medvednica. Poslije su je, u vrijeme apsolutizma, nazvali Zagrebačkom gorom. Naseljavali su je neki naši davni preci još u pretpovijesno doba, a stoljeća iskorištavanja svih njezinih bogatstava, posebice voda i šuma, nagnali su modernu civilizaciju da je 1981. proglasi parkom prirode. Mnogo više od sjenovite gore na sjeveru, ova su zagrebačka pluća i mjesto za odmor i zabavu koja u svojoj utrobi skrivaju Veternicu i njezine šišmiše, rudnike, pet stotina Horvatovih stuba, planinarske domove i kapelice. I priče o drevnoj povijesti, one koje se pričaju u Zagrebu - o Crnoj Kraljici i blagu zakopanu pod drevnim Medvedgradom te one koje se pričaju u Hrvatskom zagorju - o Kamenim svatima i Seljačkoj buni. I vode... Vode koje izviru pod krošnjama sljemenskim i odlaze mirnim tokom prema sjeveru - u Zagorje, te prema jugu - u Zagreb, donose život u sve, pa i najudaljenije i najtamnije kutke Medvednice. R.: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator)...

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: As it is said - (E04, Show Magazine, Croatian) Department of Education and Science, HTV, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as young people and foreign words in Croatian are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter ... / Kako se kaže - (E04, show magazin, Hrvatska) Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter...

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Third age - (educational program, Croatia) "Doctor, I forget," is a sentence that is difficult to pronounce, and with a diagnosis that confirms doubt is even harder to face. It is estimated that 87,000 people suffer from Alzheimer's and other dementia in Croatia. Care and care for patients are insufficient. Often, they are stigmatized by themselves, members of their families and guardians. Medicines, which can slow down the progression of the disease, are often unavailable to patients due to the price. The support of the local community in the struggle with this serious and incurable disease is of great importance. The newly established Association of Unforgettable in Zagreb is one of the few that will provide the patients with assistance in care and everyday life. Dr. Sanja Klaić Gotić, Head of the Counseling Center for patients with Alzheimer and other dementia of the Health Center East Zagreb and Milenka Petrovic Šekoranja from the KNAP Seniors Club ... will be spoken of today. / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) "Doktore, ja zaboravljam", rečenica je koju je teško izgovoriti, a s dijagnozom koja potvrdi sumnju još se teže suočiti. Procjenjuje se da od Alzheimerove i drugih demencija u Hrvatskoj boluje 87.000 osoba. Skrb i briga za oboljele nedostatne su. Nerijetko su stigmatizirani sami oboljeli, članovi njihovih obitelji i skrbnici. Lijekovi, koji mogu usporiti napredovanje bolesti, često su zbog cijene nedostupni oboljelima. Podrška lokalne zajednice u borbi s ovom teškom i neizlječivom bolesti od velike je važnosti. Novoosnovana udruga Nezaboravak u Zagrebu jedna je od rijetkih koja će oboljelima i njihovim obiteljima pružati pomoć u skrbi i svakodnevici. O ovoj epidemiji današnjice u emisiji će govoriti doktorica Sanja Klaić Grotić, voditeljica savjetovališta za oboljele od Alzheimera i drugih demencija Doma zdravlja Istok Zagreb i Milenka Petrović Šekoranja iz Kluba seniora KNAP-a...

programme.title: The other side / Druga strana
programme.desc: The other side - (educational program, Croatia) Hanfa has approved them a prospectus and are now allowed to speak publicly about the new great Croatian IPO. Exclusively for the other side - all about the upcoming public offer to the citizens of Croatia and the business plans of the Tokić group, the CEO Ivan Šantorić reveals. ---- when your name grows into a generic term, it is a great success of the brand. Caladont is a general name for all toothpastes, and Tokic for autodies trade. While others are speculating on the initial public offer of shares, we bring the facts. Exclusively for the other side, Ivan Santoric, CEO of Tokic Group Management Board, speaks of the regional leader. Like any romanticized business story, Ilija and Stojan started from a small store of only thirty square meters in Kranjcevic Street in Zagreb. After only 35 years, from the modest family trade of autodies, they grew into the Tokic group - a regional leader with more than 123 branches in Croatia and Slovenia, a portfolio of over 300,000 items and a network that employs more than 1300 people. But that's not enough for them - they want more. They were transformed into a joint stock company and they want you to become their shareholders. And now you ask yourself: Why would anyone give money to a completely private company tokic family? What about that money? How reliable are they? And how stable their business is at a time when each new car is increasingly resembling a cell phone on wheels, and without a laptop you can't even replace the battery? Who today needs a chain of shops that sell carbuits and refrigerators (or, Croatian stated - balls, killers and gete)? ... / Druga strana - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) HANFA im je odobrila prospekt i sada smiju javno govoriti o novom velikom hrvatskom IPO-u. Ekskluzivno za Drugu stranu - sve o predstojećoj javnoj ponudi građanima Hrvatske i poslovnim planovima grupe Tokić otkriva njihov predsjednik uprave Ivan Šantorić. ---- Kad vam ime preraste u generički pojam, to je veliki uspjeh brenda. Kaladont je opći naziv za sve zubne paste, a Tokić za trgovine autodijelovima. Dok drugi špekuliraju o inicijalnoj javnoj ponudi dionica, mi donosimo činjenice. Ekskluzivno za Drugu stranu, o regionalnom lideru govori Ivan Šantorić, predsjednik uprave Tokić grupe. Kao i svaka romantizirana poslovna priča, Ilija i Stojan krenuli su od male trgovine od samo tridesetak kvadrata u Kranjčevićevoj ulici u Zagrebu. Nakon samo 35 godina, od skromne obiteljske trgovine autodijelova prerasli su u Tokić Grupu - regionalnog lidera s više od 123 poslovnice u Hrvatskoj i Sloveniji, portfeljem od preko 300 tisuća artikala i mrežom koja zapošljava više od 1300 ljudi. No to im nije dovoljno - žele još. Preoblikovali su se u dioničko društvo i žele da i vi postanete njihovi dioničari. I sada se pitate: Zašto bi netko dao novac potpuno privatnoj tvrtki obitelji Tokić? Što će oni s tim novcem? Koliko su pouzdani? A koliko je stabilan njihov biznis u vremenu kada svaki novi automobil sve više nalikuje mobitelu na kotačima, a bez laptopa ne možete zamijeniti ni akumulator? Kome danas treba lanac trgovina koje prodaju rasplinjače i hladnjake (ili, hrvatski rečeno - kuglagere, kilere i getribe)?...

programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) a documentary about charms shows a life in a small town in the center of the island of Korcula, which connects tradition and modern life in the best possible way. The story of the Krajančić family vineyard shows the cultivation of old grape varieties and a modern processing mode. In charm, we witness the preservation of old customs, dances and legends in accordance with the modern way of life and work. The sock is located in the heart of the island of Korcula and is one of the oldest places on the island. It is located on a hill below which is a large Čarško field on which a parip, an autochthonous grape variety of which has been produced for centuries, has been produced by a unique Posip wine. Apart from the wine, the sock is widely known for the churches of long and rich history, almonds, great cypress and legends. In the charm we also filmed the Crnomir Brothers Cultural and Art Society, named after the legendary brothers who once boldly fought for the rights of peasants against the Venetian nobility and prince. In charms, returnees, people who have found their home again here from far Australia and America ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Dokumentarni film o Čari prikazuje život u malom mjestu u središtu otoka Korčule u kojem se spajaju tradicija i suvremeni život na najbolji mogući način. Priča o obiteljskom vinogradu Krajančića prikazuje uzgoj starih sorti grožđa i suvremeni način prerade. U Čari svjedočimo očuvanju starih običaja, plesova i legendi u skladu sa suvremenim načinom života i rada. Čara se nalazi u srcu otoka Korčule i jedno je od najstarijih mjesta na otoku. Smještena je na brdu ispod kojeg se nalazi veliko Čarsko polje na kojem se uzgaja pošip, autohtona sorta grožđa od kojeg se već stoljećima proizvodi jedinstveno vino pošip. Osim po vinu, Čara je nadaleko poznata po crkvicama duge i bogate povijesti, bademima, velikom čempresu i legendama. U Čari smo snimili i kulturno-umjetničko društvo Braća Črnomir koje je ime dobilo po legendarnoj braći koja su se nekada davno hrabro borila za prava seljaka protiv mletačkog plemstva i kneza. U Čari žive i povratnici, ljudi koji su iz daleke Australije i Amerike ovdje ponovno našli svoj dom...

programme.title: Geostorm / Geostorm
programme.desc: While a man goes to the outer space to prevent the satellite network in the climate, from raising a devastating storm after it protected the planet from many natural disasters over three years, his brother tries to kidnap the American president to force him to solve the crisis, so each of them has to confront the danger that he faces on his side to prevent the achieved catastrophe. / بينما يتوجه رجل إلى الفضاء الخارجي لمنع شبكة الأقمار المتحكمة في ظروف المُناخ، من إثارة عاصفة مدمرة بعد أن حمت الكوكب من كوارث طبيعية عديدة على مدار ثلاث سنوات، يحاول شقيقه خطف الرئيس اﻷمريكي ﻹجباره على حل الأزمة، فيكون على كل منهم مجابهة الخطر الذي يواجهه في جانبه لمنع وقوع الكارثة المحققة.

programme.title: Passengers / Passengers
programme.desc: The Afalon spacecraft (Avalon) starts on a hundred and twenty -year -old journey to colonize a remote planet, and this is by transporting 5,259 human being there while covering in deep hibernation, but a defect in the bedrooms occurs and two traveling travels wake up prematurely; To find themselves, they have been cut off on the spacecraft, and ninety years are still to reach the destination of the ship. / تنطلق المركبة الفضائية (أفالون) في رحلة عمرها مائة وعشرين عامًا لاستعمار كوكب بعيد، وهذا من خلال نقل 5,259 بشري إلى هناك بينما يغطون في سُبات عميق، لكن يحدث خلل في غرف النوم فيستيقظ مسافران قبل الأوان؛ ليجدا أنفسهما قد تقطعت بهما السبل على سفينة الفضاء، ولا زال تسعين عامًا للوصول إلى وجهة السفينة.

programme.title: Interstellar / Interstellar
programme.desc: Dirt is spread throughout the land, diseases that strike natural resources, and the human race becomes vulnerable to annihilation; Because of the lack of food and the spread of epidemics, therefore a group of explorers, led by the astronaut (Cooper), seeks to travel on an unknown space flight through the worm hole in order to search for a homeland and another planet that is suitable for life to save mankind. / تنتشر الأتربة في بقاع اﻷرض، والأمراض التي تضرب الموارد الطبيعية، ويصبح الجنس البشري معرض للفناء؛ بسبب نقص الطعام وانتشار الأوبئة، ولذلك يسعى مجموعة من المستكشفين بقيادة رائد الفضاء (كوبر) إلى السفر في رحلة فضائية مجهولة من خلال الثقب الدودي من أجل البحث عن موطن وكوكب آخر يصلح للحياة من أجل إنقاذ البشرية.

programme.title: Anti Life / Anti Life
programme.desc: Motivated by paternity, a mechanic has a novice on board the stars in its direction to the new Earth to do everything in his power, when the danger seeks to control the ship and use it as a space weapon. / بدافع الأبوة، يصبح على ميكانيكي مبتدئ على متن سفية عبر النجوم في إتجاهها إلى الأرض الجديدة أن يفعل كل ما في وسعه، حينما يظهر الخطر الذي يسعى للسيطرة على السفينة واستخدامها كسلاح فضائي.

programme.title: Green Book / Green Book
programme.desc: The story revolves around Tony Lip (Vigo Mortinson), an Italian American goalkeeper who is hiring in 1962 to work as a driver for Dr. Don Shirley (Maherchala Ali); One of the finest jazz musicians in the world, as he takes him on a tour between the landmarks of South America .. The journey can open the eyes of each of them to the other man's world, as well as directing their insight to the world in which they live. / تدور القصة حول توني ليب (فيجو مورتينسون)، حارس إيطالي أمريكي يتم استئجاره عام 1962 ليعمل سائقًا لصالح د. دون شيرلي (ماهرشالا علي)؛ واحد من أرقي عازفي موسيقى الجاز في العالم، حيث يأخذه في جولة بين معالم جنوب أمريكا.. وتتمكن الرحلة من فتح أعين كل رجل منهما على عالم الرجل الآخر، فضلًا عن توجيه بصيرتهما للعالم الذي يعيشان به.

programme.title: The Green Mile / The Green Mile
programme.desc: (Paul) is a guardian of the prisoners who are sentenced to death, and he is known for his sarcasm and extreme mockery, and his ability to control his nerves, and his skill in his work, arrives (Kofi); He is sentenced to death, on charges of killing two children, Paul discovers that Kofi, despite the magnitude of his body, and the ugliness of his crime, possesses the heart of a child, and supernatural abilities, which changes his life and the life of his colleagues completely. / (بول) حارس لزنازين المساجين المحكوم عليهم بالإعدام، وهو معروف بتهكمه وسخريته الشديدة، وقدرته على التحكم في أعصابه، ومهارته في عمله، يصل(كوفي)؛ وهو محكوم عليه بالإعدام، بتهمة قتل طفلين، يكتشف بول أن كوفي على الرغم من ضخامة جسده، وبشاعة جريمته، يمتلك قلب طفل، وقدرات سحرية خارقة، ذلك الأمر الذي يُغيّر حياته وحياة زملائه تمامًا.

programme.title: Arabi / العربجي
programme.desc: A dramatic epic that ignites fire from the womb of injustice and darkness, where the story of Abdo Al -Arbaji, which works to transport goods on Tanbar; To support his family. However, Abu Hamza's injustice to him enter into conflicts with him and his son Hamza. Between hatred of a role, and the revenge of Drie Khanm - the wife of Abu Hamza's brother - how will Abdo face the intrigues? Will it remain for love from a place in the shadow of all these wars? / ملحمة درامية تُشعل النار من رحم الظلم والظلام، وذلك حيث قصة عبده العربجي، الذي يعمل على نقل البضائع على الطنبر؛ لإعالة عائلته. لكنّ ظلم أبو حمزة النشواتي له يُدخله في صراعات معه ومع ابنه حمزة. وبين حقد بدور، وانتقام دريّة خانم - زوجة شقيق أبو حمزة- كيف سيُواجه عبده المكائد؟ وهل سيبقى للحبّ من مكان في ظلّ كلّ هذه الحروب؟

programme.title: Abdulaziz Street / شارع عبدالعزيز
programme.desc: Abdel Aziz goes through many fluctuations that any young man goes through at the beginning of his life, through his joining one of the Islamic groups, then he leaves it to join the left political current and works in the end on Abdel Aziz Street, then he is able to achieve wealth, as he becomes one of the largest merchants of the shop there. / يمر عبد العزيز بالعديد من التقلبات التي يمر بها أي شاب في بداية حياته مرورًا بانضمامه إلى إحدى الجماعات اﻹسلامية ثم يتركها لينضم إلى التيار السياسي اليساري ويعمل في النهاية بشارع عبد العزيز ثم يتمكن من تحقيق الثراء حيث يصبح أحد اكبر تجار المحال هناك.

programme.title: Faces / وجوه
programme.desc: The series of faces is divided into two stories: What are you, and Mitafs. The story of a doctor who graduated from the prison was presented to start a journey of searching for her daughter and the journey of facing psychosis. In Metaver, the heroine rejects life in reality and storms the virtual world to take revenge on its enemies. / ينقسم مسلسل وجوه إلى قصتين: وش تالت، وميتافرس. تقدم وش تالت قصة طبيبة تخرج من السجن لتبدأ رحلة بحث عن ابنتها ورحلة مواجهة مرض الذهان. أما في ميتافرس، ترفض البطلة الحياة في الواقع وتقتحم العالم الافتراضي لتنتقم لنفسها من أعدائها.

programme.title: Stone / قلع الحجر
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the series revolves around in Upper Egypt, about a story that has already occurred, where the mayor (Farmawi), and the rebel young man (Abdeli) who enters into several crises due to the domination of his parents, as well as the work of women's rights. / في إطار درامي، تدور أحداث المسلسل في الصعيد، حول قصة حدثت بالفعل، حيث العمدة (فرماوي)، والشاب المتمرد (عبدالحي) الذي يدخل في عدة أزمات بسبب تسلط والديه، كما يتطرق العمل إلى قضية حقوق المرأة.

programme.title: With 100 men / بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events revolve around (Ghalia Abu Al -Dahab) that faces many troubles, and after the killing of her husband (Adel) during their wedding ceremony, (Ghalia) is forced to work as a microbus driver; And face many shocks, the most important of which is her imprisonment. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن.

programme.title: Shame / العار
programme.desc: The events of the series revolve around the family of Hajj Abdel Sattar, who trades in drugs and helps his older son without knowing his family, and when Abdel -Sattar dies, his sons know the truth of the matter from their older brother, so they decide to complete the agreed drug deal, and so that their money is not lost. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول أسرة الحاج عبد الستار الذي يتاجر في المخدرات ويعاونه ابنه الأكبر دون أن تدري عائلته، وعندما يتوفى عبدالستار يعلم ابناؤه بحقيقة الأمر من شقيقهم الأكبر، فيقرروا إتمام صفقة المخدرات المتفق عليها، وحتى لا تضيع أموالهم، .

programme.title: Tears / دموع في عيون وقحة
programme.desc: A story based on real events from the Egyptian spy files of one of the Egyptian intelligence operations against the Israeli Mossad, whose hero was in fact (Ahmed Mohamed Abdel Rahman Al -Hwan), who became in the series (Jumaa Al -Shawan) .. He is an Egyptian young man who grew up in a miserable social environment, carrying a heavy pregnancy, which is the support of his poor family, which consists of his elderly elderly mother, his blind wife, and his disgraceful brother .. He works in the port (Suez), and if he receives an attractive offer, he discovers that its source is the Israeli Mossad and the regular intelligence services, which aspire to recruit him to work as a spy on his homeland, and motivated by his patriotism and his Egyptian affiliation rushes (Jumaa Al -Shawan) to inform the Egyptian security services, and they ask him to continue playing the same role; To dictate to the enemy's intelligence information, some of which are correct, some of which are false, and the events continue as it continues to work with the Israeli Mossad as a double customer for them inside Egypt for a period of six years, so that he can finally get the rarest and the most dangerous broadcasting devices in the world during that time, to write with his intelligence and patriotism one of the most wonderful seasons of Egyptian patriotism, addressed to the Israeli enemy a strong slap. / قصة مبنية على أحداث حقيقية من ملفات الجاسوسية المصرية لإحدى عمليات المخابرات المصرية ضد الموساد الإسرائيلي، والتي كان بطلها في الحقيقة (أحمد محمد عبد الرحمن الهوان)، والذي أصبح في المسلسل (جمعة الشوان).. وهو شاب مصري نشأ في ظل بيئة اجتماعية بائسة، يحمل حملًا ثقيلًا، وهو إعالة عائلته الفقيرة، والتي تتكون من أمه الطيبة المسنة، زوجته الكفيفة، وشقيقه المستهتر.. بينما كان (جمعة الشوان) يعمل في ميناء (السويس) وإذا به يتلقى عرضًا مغريًا يكتشف أن مصدره هو الموساد الإسرائيلي وأجهزة المخابرات العادية، والتي تطمح في تجنيده ليعمل جاسوسًا على وطنه، وبدافع من وطنيته وانتمائه المصري يسارع (جمعة الشوان) إلى إبلاغ أجهزة الأمن المصرية، فيطلبون منه الاستمرار في لعب نفس الدور؛ ليُملي على مخابرات العدو معلومات بعضها صحيح، وبعضها زائف، وتتوالى الأحداث حيث يستمر في العمل مع الموساد الإسرائيلي كعميل مزدوج لهم داخل مصر لمدة ست سنوات كاملة، حتى يتمكن في النهاية من الحصول على أندر وأخطر أجهزة إرسال البث في العالم خلال ذلك الوقت، ليكتب بذكائه ووطنيته واحداً من أروع فصول الوطنية المصرية، موجهًا للعدو الإسرائيلي صفعة قوية.

programme.title: Modern and supplication program / برنامج حديث ودعاء
Fawazir events / فوازير المناسبات
programme.desc: In its episodes, Al -Fawazir deals with a daily question about a specific social occasion, which is embodied and represented through a comic story, and at the end of each episode a review of the occasion. / تتناول الفوازير في حلقاتها سؤال بشكل يومي عن مناسبة اجتماعية معينة، يتم تجسيدها وتمثيلها من خلال قصة كوميدية، وفي نهاية كل حلقة استعراض عن المناسبة.

programme.title: One Thousand and One Nights: Bride of the Sea / ألف ليلة وليلة: عروس البحور
programme.desc: A strange love story that grows between the human being, Prince Nour and Princess Arous, which does not have legs, but a tail like fish, and the bride of the sea tries to become human as her lover until her love succeeds. / قصة حب غريبة تنمو بين البشري الأمير نور والأميرة عروس البحر التي لا تمتلك ساقين وإنما ذيلًا مثل اﻷسماك، وتحاول عروس البحر أن تصير آدمية مثل حبيبها حتى ينجح حبها.

programme.title: The modern soul program / برنامج حديث الروح
And the sea said / وقال البحر
programme.desc: Salem falls into the trap of greed when he finds a treasure in the sea of ​​the sea, and his life quickly changes and escapes from his country, and soon the past returns to chase him while everyone tries to reach him to obtain their right to the treasure. / يسقط سالم في فخ الطمع حينما يعثر على كنز في بئر بقاع البحر، وسرعان ما تتغير حياته ويهرب من بلده، وسرعان ما يعود الماضي ليطارده بينما يحاول الجميع الوصول له للحصول على حقهم في الكنز.

programme.title: God's Most Beautiful Names Program / برنامج أسماء الله الحسنى
Money / الفلوس
programme.desc: (Azmi) has a huge wealth, and all those belonging to his family hope to seize his wealth after his death because of his poor treatment of them and because of his stinginess, while (Azmi) prevents his brother from the mother (Saad) to take any part of his money. / يمتلك (عزمي) ثروة طائلة، ويأمل كل المنتمين لعائلته في الاستيلاء على ثروته عقب وفاته بسبب سوء معاملته لهم وبسبب بخله، بينما يعمل (عزمي) على منع أخيه من الأم (سعد) في أخذ أي جزء من أمواله.

programme.title: Modern and supplication program / برنامج حديث ودعاء
film / فيلم
The watch was born / ساعة ولد الهدى
programme.desc: A religious historical series, its events begin in the year 570 AD and the year of the birth of the Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the following events. / مسلسل تاريخي ديني، تبدأ أحداثه في عام 570 م وعام ميلاد النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وما تلاها من أحداث.

programme.desc: Salem falls into the trap of greed when he finds a treasure in the sea of ​​the sea, and his life quickly changes and escapes from his country, and soon the past returns to chase him while everyone tries to reach him to obtain their right to the treasure. / يسقط سالم في فخ الطمع حينما يعثر على كنز في بئر بقاع البحر، وسرعان ما تتغير حياته ويهرب من بلده، وسرعان ما يعود الماضي ليطارده بينما يحاول الجميع الوصول له للحصول على حقهم في الكنز.

Among people / بين الناس
programme.desc: Jamal Al -Shaer shows part of a play or series, and then asks people about the issue or the problem that was presented or the artwork has been discussed to discuss. / يعرض جمال الشاعر جزء من مسرحية أو مسلسل، ثم يسأل بعد ذلك الناس عن القضية أو المشكلة التي عُرضت أو حاول العمل الفني مناقشتها.

programme.title: Tears / دموع في عيون وقحة
programme.desc: A story based on real events from the Egyptian spy files of one of the Egyptian intelligence operations against the Israeli Mossad, whose hero was in fact (Ahmed Mohamed Abdel Rahman Al -Hwan), who became in the series (Jumaa Al -Shawan) .. He is an Egyptian young man who grew up in a miserable social environment, carrying a heavy pregnancy, which is the support of his poor family, which consists of his elderly elderly mother, his blind wife, and his disgraceful brother .. He works in the port (Suez), and if he receives an attractive offer, he discovers that its source is the Israeli Mossad and the regular intelligence services, which aspire to recruit him to work as a spy on his homeland, and motivated by his patriotism and his Egyptian affiliation rushes (Jumaa Al -Shawan) to inform the Egyptian security services, and they ask him to continue playing the same role; To dictate to the enemy's intelligence information, some of which are correct, some of which are false, and the events continue as it continues to work with the Israeli Mossad as a double customer for them inside Egypt for a period of six years, so that he can finally get the rarest and the most dangerous broadcasting devices in the world during that time, to write with his intelligence and patriotism one of the most wonderful seasons of Egyptian patriotism, addressed to the Israeli enemy a strong slap. / قصة مبنية على أحداث حقيقية من ملفات الجاسوسية المصرية لإحدى عمليات المخابرات المصرية ضد الموساد الإسرائيلي، والتي كان بطلها في الحقيقة (أحمد محمد عبد الرحمن الهوان)، والذي أصبح في المسلسل (جمعة الشوان).. وهو شاب مصري نشأ في ظل بيئة اجتماعية بائسة، يحمل حملًا ثقيلًا، وهو إعالة عائلته الفقيرة، والتي تتكون من أمه الطيبة المسنة، زوجته الكفيفة، وشقيقه المستهتر.. بينما كان (جمعة الشوان) يعمل في ميناء (السويس) وإذا به يتلقى عرضًا مغريًا يكتشف أن مصدره هو الموساد الإسرائيلي وأجهزة المخابرات العادية، والتي تطمح في تجنيده ليعمل جاسوسًا على وطنه، وبدافع من وطنيته وانتمائه المصري يسارع (جمعة الشوان) إلى إبلاغ أجهزة الأمن المصرية، فيطلبون منه الاستمرار في لعب نفس الدور؛ ليُملي على مخابرات العدو معلومات بعضها صحيح، وبعضها زائف، وتتوالى الأحداث حيث يستمر في العمل مع الموساد الإسرائيلي كعميل مزدوج لهم داخل مصر لمدة ست سنوات كاملة، حتى يتمكن في النهاية من الحصول على أندر وأخطر أجهزة إرسال البث في العالم خلال ذلك الوقت، ليكتب بذكائه ووطنيته واحداً من أروع فصول الوطنية المصرية، موجهًا للعدو الإسرائيلي صفعة قوية.

programme.title: film / فيلم
Money / الفلوس
programme.desc: (Azmi) has a huge wealth, and all those belonging to his family hope to seize his wealth after his death because of his poor treatment of them and because of his stinginess, while (Azmi) prevents his brother from the mother (Saad) to take any part of his money. / يمتلك (عزمي) ثروة طائلة، ويأمل كل المنتمين لعائلته في الاستيلاء على ثروته عقب وفاته بسبب سوء معاملته لهم وبسبب بخله، بينما يعمل (عزمي) على منع أخيه من الأم (سعد) في أخذ أي جزء من أمواله.

A rich man .. very poor / رجل غني .. فقير جدًا
programme.desc: The events revolve around a man who becomes a billionaire, and he believes that he owned the world, including, and then discovers that he is very poor because he lacks peace of mind and reassurance, and this is due to reasons, including the continuous American threats of the life of the big Arab family. / تدور الأحداث حول رجل يصبح مليارديرًا، فيعتقد أنه امتلك العالم بما فيه، ثم يكتشف أنه فقير جدًا لأنه يفتقد راحة البال والطمأنينة، ويعود هذا الى أسباب منها التهديدات الأميركية المستمرة لحياة الأسرة العربية الكبيرة.

programme.title: Deviation / انحراف
programme.desc: The series is taken from real events, which revolve in a teaser drama full of mystery, about the deviation of a number of personalities from human nature; They collide with a psychiatrist and decide to adjust the path in its own way. / المسلسل مأخوذ عن أحداث حقيقية، تدور فى دراما تشويقية مليئة بالغموض، حول انحراف عدد من الشخصيات عن الطبيعة البشرية؛ يصطدمون بطبيبة نفسية وتقرر تعديل المسار بطريقتها الخاصة.

programme.title: The wife is the first to know / الزوجة أول من يعلم
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around four friends who decide to rent an apartment to make it an import and export company, but without the knowledge of their wives, then they appoint a secretary to work with them in the company, so that the wives get to know each other, know the existence of the apartment and believe that their husbands use them to betray them, to escalate the events. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول اربعة من أصدقاء يقرروا إستئجار شقة لجعلها شركة للإستيراد والتصدير ولكن بدون علم زوجاتهم، ثم يقوموا بتعيين سكرتيرة للعمل معهم بالشركة، لتتعرف الزوجات ببعضهن، ويعلمن بوجود الشقة ويعتقدن أن أزواجهن يستخدمنها لخيانتهن، لتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: In the blink of an eye / في غمضة عين
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around (Fatima) and (Nabila), two friends, who were raised together with one of the orphans, until they worked two supervisors in the same shelter, suffering from the cruelty of life in the shelter, until Nabila discovers that she has a wealthy uncle and she goes to see him, and on the way an accident occurs and her friend believes that she died, and events escalate. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول (فاطمة) و(نبيلة) وهما صديقتان، تربيتا معاَ بأحد ملاجيء الأيتام، حتى عملتا مشرفتين في الملجأ نفسه، تعانيان من قسوة الحياة في الملجأ، حتى تكتشف نبيلة أن لها عم ثري فتذهب لرؤيته، وفي الطريق تقع حادثة وتعتقد صديقتها أنها ماتت، وتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: Disobedience c 1 / العصيان ج1
programme.desc: Social drama, which discusses the human relations interfering between members of the same family, especially if they are exposed to the temptation of money and does it spoil the souls of human beings to the degree that makes the son covet the money of his father and asks for stone on him under pressure and his wife is urgent. / دراما إجتماعية، تناقش العلاقات الإنسانية المتداخلة بين أفراد الأسرة الواحدة وخاصة إذا ما تعرضوا لإغراء المال وهل يفسد نفوس البشر للدرجة التى تجعل الإبن يطمع فى مال أبيه ويطلب الحجر عليه تحت ضغط والحاح زوجته.

programme.title: Digger / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by the Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the war of attrition, Israel announced that it had carried out extensive operations to excavate oil in the Sinai and rent a digger to carry out this task, and this matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities with the appearance of a little trick in front of what Israel is doing, which prompted the Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the digger before reaching the door. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: Adam and Jamila / آدم وجميلة
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman (Yousra Al -Lawzi) in her uncle's house among his wife and daughter, and despite the loss of her parents and her upbringing in the house of a hateful, arrogant man possessing greed and love of money and influence, she learned patience and formed with love and tenderness. The days are away from Adam (Hassan Al -Raddad), the companion of her childhood, whose father forces him to marry a wealthy woman to achieve his personal interests and aspirations. programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend. / The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. programme.title: Basketball: Euroleague. FC Bayern - Crvena Zvezda / Basketbols: Eirolīga. FC Bayern - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. Tajemný zámek pod Černou hláskou nedá chudemu mistrovi od teto chvíle pokoje, a tak místo práce sedí doma, probírá se ve vypůjčených mapách a vlastivědných knížkách, toulá se krajem, všude se vyptává na tajemný hrad. Řemeslo chátrá, žena a děti strádají, kdekdo se truhláři vysmívá, ale on myslí jenom na poklad…

programme.title: Folkloric / Folklorika
programme.desc: Thrombits - large Bačovský oven - are associated with sheep expelled. Also, they were announced by the imminent danger. The whistles of all kinds then served for herd sheep herd - when played, the sheep were calm and felt safe. Trombits are now used on festive occasions. Unfortunately, there are no many people who can make and play them. The documentary introduces us to the three skeletons of artists who have linked their lives with these giant Fujari, both in Czech, Slovak and Polish side… / Trombity – velke bačovske trouby – jsou spojeny s vyháněním ovcí. Take se jejich pomocí oznamovalo hrozící nebezpečí. Píšťalky všeho druhu pak sloužily pro pasení stáda ovcí – když se hrálo, ovce byly klidne a cítily se v bezpečí. Trombity se dnes take používají při slavnostních příležitostech. Bohužel už není hodně lidí, kteří je umějí vyrobit a zahrát na ně. Dokument nás zavádí za třemi sveráznými umělci, kteří svůj život s těmito obřími fujarami spojili, a to jak na česke, tak i slovenske a polske straně…

programme.title: The paths of faith / Cesty víry
programme.desc: The cities located on the territory of today's southeast Poland and Ukraine sometimes still have the cores of the original Jewish towns - the businesses in which many reformers of Judaism, starting with the false Messiah Jakob, ended with many miraculous rabbis of the Hasidism movement. Many descendants of the original Hasids living today mainly on the east coast of the US and Israel, claim the Cadics - spiritual leaders - and their former communities in their original place of residence. That is why the so -called Jorcajs - the anniversary associated with specific miraculous men, mostly traditionally worshiped as their tombs, take place every year. Very interesting in this respect is the town of Ležajsk, the traditional goal of the expeditions of the American and Israeli trinkets, which works a few days a year through ecstatic performances and traditional clothing truly exotic. In addition to Ležajsk, the guide of the program Janusz Klimsza will take us to Lublin and Ukrainian Belz, where the Czech Jewish writer Jiří once worked ... / Města ležící na území dnešního jihovýchodního Polska a Ukrajiny mají občas ještě jádra původních židovských městeček – štetlů, ve kterých působila řada reformátorů judaismu, počínaje falešným mesiášem Jakobem Frankem, konče mnoha zázračnými rabíny hnutí chasidismu, jenž právě v těchto končinách mělo svou genezi. Spousta potomků původních chasidů, žijících dnes hlavně na východním pobřeží USA a v Izraeli, se hlásí k cadikům – duchovním vůdcům – a jejich bývalým komunitám v původním místě bydliště. Proto se každoročně konají tzv. jorcajty – výročí spjatá s konkretními zázračnými muži, většinou kolem míst tradičně uctívaných jako jejich hrobky. Velmi zajímave je v tomto ohledu městečko Ležajsk, tradiční cíl výprav amerických i izraelských chasidů, ktere pár dnů v roce působí i skrze extaticke vystupování a tradiční oděv vskutku exoticky. Kromě Ležajsku nás průvodce pořadem Janusz Klimsza zavede take do Lublinu a ukrajinskeho Belzu, kde kdysi působil český židovský spisovatel Jiří...
